name: Hello WebAssembly
description: The example mod as a sandboxed WebAssembly module: lifecycle, game events, the main menu, a /hellowasm chat command with settings, a key (Ctrl+Shift+W), messages between mods and JASS natives.
natives: native HelloWasmAdd takes integer a, integer b returns integer
native HelloWasmHalf takes real value returns real
native HelloWasmGreet takes string name returns string
native HelloWasmSame takes unit u returns unit
native HelloWasmCall takes code callback returns boolean
